title: Si: relax, SCF, bands and DOS (PBE)
description: A four-stage pipeline on the two-atom silicon cell with an automatic k mesh, a band structure along the standard path and a density of states.
goal: Relax silicon, then calculate PBE bands and DOS.
source: VASP 6.2.1 on a Slurm cluster, from the v0.4.1 validation set
note: Cluster names, accounts and paths were replaced with placeholders.
